question: Why is levofloxacin short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.
steps.finding: 4 stock lines across 2 hospitals, 2 presentations, in units of use.

steps.title: Where our supply is made
steps.purpose: Follow each product's label to the plants it names, and place each plant in FDA's registration file.
steps.finding: 2 plant links on 2 labels; 2 placed in FDA's registration file.

steps.title: What FDA says about this shortage
steps.purpose: Read FDA's current shortage list and its history for this drug.
steps.finding: Not on FDA's current shortage list.

steps.title: Who else makes it
steps.purpose: List every labeler of this drug in the same form, and the plants their labels name.
steps.finding: 31 labelers make it in this form.

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.
steps.finding: 25 inspections (1 OAI at our plants), 2 compliance actions, 0 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.

explanation.headline: Levofloxacin is not on FDA's shortage list; current stock covers 13.6 to 25.2 days across sites

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include levofloxacin as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 238 tablets of the 750 mg strength at 15.1 tablets per day, providing 15.7 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 207 tablets of the 750 mg strength at 15.3 tablets per day, providing 13.6 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 315 tablets of the 500 mg strength at 17.1 tablets per day, providing 18.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 394 tablets of the 500 mg strength at 15.6 tablets per day, providing 25.2 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list and is supplied from Hetero Labs Limited Unit V, last inspected VAI on 2022-08-12.
Secondary options include Aurobindo Pharma Limited and Chartwell RX, LLC, neither of which is on FDA's shortage list, though their labels name no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
